name: Opening a Callboard Cache tells the client to leave the looting state
contract: Opening an item sends CMSG_OPEN_ITEM, and the client enters its looting state until the server sends
SMSG_LOOT_RELEASE_RESPONSE for that item. A Callboard Cache opens without a loot window, so without that packet
the client stays in the looting state and refuses the next loot action with 'You are busy looting' (#11208).
A Heroic Dungeon Callboard Cache (1615001) is opened through the open packet: the cache is used up and the
hero is sent exactly one item loot release, as opening an Adventurer Cache already does.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero holds the cache
CONTROL: no item loot release has been sent yet
The client was told to leave the looting state
